verdict.rationale: A government tax and licensing portal like My DOR could plausibly offer outbound event callbacks, such as filing-status or license-approval notifications, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable webhooks. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the transactional portal sits behind an authenticated login, so there is no sign of any programmatic event subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
